#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
cd /root/autodl-tmp/recursive_gen_depth_est

DATA_DIR=data/olmo_temp09
RESULTS_DIR=results/olmo_temp09
MODEL_PATH=/root/autodl-tmp/models/olmo-1b-hf
mkdir -p "$RESULTS_DIR/three_class" "$RESULTS_DIR/three_class_filtered"

echo "=== Step 2: Feature extraction ==="
python scripts/extract_features.py --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" --output_path "$RESULTS_DIR/features.jsonl" --gpu 0 --batch_size 16

echo "=== Step 3: 4-class classification ==="
python scripts/train_classifier.py --features_path "$RESULTS_DIR/features.jsonl" --output_dir "$RESULTS_DIR"

echo "=== Step 4: 3-class d1d2d3 ==="
python3 scripts/filter_features_d1d3.py "$RESULTS_DIR/features.jsonl" "$RESULTS_DIR/features_3class.jsonl"
python scripts/train_classifier.py --features_path "$RESULTS_DIR/features_3class.jsonl" --output_dir "$RESULTS_DIR/three_class"

echo "=== Step 5: 3-class filtered ==="
for d in 1 2 3; do
    python scripts/filter_code.py --input "$DATA_DIR/depth_$d.jsonl" --mode filter --output "$RESULTS_DIR/depth_${d}_filtered.jsonl"
done
FILTERED_DIR="$RESULTS_DIR/filtered_tmp"
mkdir -p "$FILTERED_DIR"
ln -sf "$(pwd)/$DATA_DIR/depth_0.jsonl" "$FILTERED_DIR/depth_0.jsonl"
for d in 1 2 3; do
    ln -sf "$(pwd)/$RESULTS_DIR/depth_${d}_filtered.jsonl" "$FILTERED_DIR/depth_${d}.jsonl"
done
python scripts/extract_features.py --data_dir "$FILTERED_DIR" --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" --output_path "$RESULTS_DIR/features_filtered.jsonl" --gpu 0 --batch_size 16
python3 scripts/filter_features_d1d3.py "$RESULTS_DIR/features_filtered.jsonl" "$RESULTS_DIR/features_3class_filtered.jsonl"
python scripts/train_classifier.py --features_path "$RESULTS_DIR/features_3class_filtered.jsonl" --output_dir "$RESULTS_DIR/three_class_filtered"
rm -rf "$FILTERED_DIR"

echo "=== Eval complete ==="
echo "=== Finished at $(date) ==="
SCRIPT

# olmo_temp09_001 实验分析报告

**实验**: OLMo-1B + temperature-only τ=0.9 递归生成深度估计
**日期**: 2026-05-15
**状态**: **SUCCESS**

---

## 1. Pipeline 概要

| 阶段 | 状态 | 备注 |
|------|------|------|
| LoRA finetune ×3 | ✅ | depth_0/1/2, 3 epochs each |
| Generate ×3 | ✅ | depth_1/2/3, 5000 samples each |
| Feature extraction | ✅ | OLMo-1B perplexity features |
| 4-class classification | ✅ | RF + LR |
| 3-class classification | ✅ | d1/d2/d3 only |
| 3-class filtered | ✅ | code contamination removed |

## 2. Finetune Loss

| Depth | Final Loss |
|-------|-----------|
| depth_0 | 2.2684 |
| depth_1 | 1.6294 |
| depth_2 | 1.1769 |

Loss 逐层递减，符合预期（递归生成的文本分布逐渐窄化，更易拟合）。

## 3. Code Contamination

| Depth | Broad Filter | Narrow Filter |
|-------|-------------|---------------|
| depth_0 | 25 (0.5%) | 20 (0.4%) |
| depth_1 | 78 (1.6%) | 35 (0.7%) |
| depth_2 | 21 (0.4%) | 17 (0.3%) |
| depth_3 | 11 (0.2%) | 11 (0.2%) |

Code contamination 极低，不影响分类结果。depth_1 broad filter 略高（1.6%），但 narrow filter 仅 0.7%。

## 4. 4-Class Classification

| Classifier | Accuracy | 95% CI |

## 9. 总结

### 判定: **SUCCESS** ✅

- 4-class acc = 82.03% > 40% ✓
- d1v2 AUC = 0.9010 > 0.6 ✓

### 关键发现

1. **OLMo + temp09 是目前所有实验中 4-class 准确率最高的配置** (82.03%)
2. Temperature-only 解码在 OLMo 上效果优于 nucleus sampling (+3.26pp)
3. OLMo 在 temp09 策略下显著优于 Pythia (+5.78pp)，说明模型架构/训练数据对递归深度可检测性有重要影响
4. depth-0 完美分离（F1=1.00），主要瓶颈在 depth-2 vs depth-3 区分（AUC=0.8214）
5. Code contamination 极低（narrow ≤0.7%），filtered 版本甚至略优
6. Perplexity 分位数（p90/p75/p50）和 surprisal 统计量是最重要的区分特征
